item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Most people start the day dehydrated and blame everything else for the fog. Before anything else, drink a full glass of water. Then tie water to things you already do, like a pause between tasks or a walk. Keep a bottle in sight so the choice is easy. Small, steady sips beat catching up later. Your action: drink a full glass of water right now.
